themes.theme: Hormuz shipping attacks and risk premium
themes.summary: Tanker attacks continued near Hormuz and off Qatar and 7-day transit averages stay below most of September, while analysts expect a sticky risk premium.
VLCC rates hit records, closing the US-to-Asia arbitrage, hurting West African and long-haul FOB differentials while short-haul North Sea grades and Dated Brent are bid.
IEA, G7 and France moved to accelerate stock releases prioritizing diesel, and the transatlantic diesel arbitrage closed as US export ban prospects faded.

themes.theme: Hurricane Isaias Gulf of Mexico shut-ins
themes.summary: GOM shut-ins reached 1.283 million b/d, supporting prices, while USGC refinery exposure narrowed and ports restricted ship movements.
Trump said no US attack on Iran before November elections, pulling prices off session highs despite stepped-up attacks.

themes.theme: Middle East export recovery and rerouting
themes.summary: Middle East flows reached about 14 million b/d with Fujairah and East-West pipeline bypass volumes, though flows depend on risky STS transfers; World Bank sees recovery by mid-2027.

themes.theme: Tightening US crude balance and exports
themes.summary: US commercial crude stocks fell 3.19 million barrels to 424.13 million with exports at 4.77 million b/d and SPR at a 44-year low.

themes.theme: Russia sanctions and Black Sea disruption
themes.summary: UK sanctioned more Russian oil firms and tankers while Black Sea attacks and record freight pressured Urals and CPC flows.
